title: Offers That Are Crushing Right Now
lede: You do not invent an offer. Here are ten that are selling right now: what each one actually is, how it works, who buys it, and the offer written out in six lines.
deliverable: Ten offers understood properly, each with its six lines and the businesses running it.
body:
Most people get stuck here, not on the selling. They sit with a blank page trying to invent an offer from nothing. You do not have to invent anything. Here are ten offers that are selling right now, with the businesses running them. For each one: what it actually is, how it works, who buys it and why, and the offer written out in six lines.

Read them properly. You cannot sell something you half understand. I could sell anyone a glass of water, because I know exactly what water does and I believe in it. That certainty is calm, and calm is what closes. It comes from knowing the offer cold, not from a script.

How this works

Somebody has already spent months and real money proving that this type of business pays for this result. You do not copy them. You move the proven offer one step.

  • Same offer, new niche. A receptionist that sells to dentists sells to physios, vets and groomers.
  • Same offer, new country. Most of these are proven in the US and barely run anywhere else.
  • Same niche, slightly different offer. They sell the leads, you sell the follow up that stops those leads going cold.

Every link below opens the Meta Ad Library and shows every ad that business is running right now. The number is how many ads they had live when I checked. Nobody keeps paying for 90 versions of an offer that loses money. And where an offer needs leads, the leads come from simple ads. Plain statics on Facebook rip for local businesses, and that is the engine behind offers 3, 4 and 7.

1. AI receptionist and missed call recovery

What it is. A phone agent that answers every call the business misses, in their name, in a natural voice. It takes the details, books the appointment into their calendar, and texts the caller back if the call drops. The owner stops losing jobs to the next number on Google.

How it works. You build the voice agent with Jarvis on the business's services, hours and prices. Their number stays the same. Any call they do not pick up in 20 seconds, and everything after hours, forwards to the agent. It answers, asks what they need, books a time into the live calendar and sends a confirmation text. Every call is transcribed and summarised to the owner's phone. You set it up once and it runs.

Who buys it and why. Clinics and trades. Dental, physio, groomers, plumbers, electricians, pest control. A tradie on the tools misses calls every day, and every one of them was a job worth hundreds or thousands. You charge a setup fee and a monthly fee, priced against the receptionist or answering service it replaces.

Running it now. Nova Codes, 92 ads, one per niche: "Every grooming call answered and booked". Switched On AI in Australia: "Answers your phone when you can't". Marblism is software, but study the line: "Skip the $2,000 a month assistant", 184 ads.

The offer in six lines
NichePlumbing companies with three or more vans
OutcomeEvery missed call answered and the job booked, day and night
TimeframeLive in 14 days
Risk reversalIf it does not book a job in the first 30 days, you pay nothing
Authority or proofRing the demo line and hear it book you in
Unique mechanismThe After Hours Booking Agent, trained on your services and reading your live calendar

2. Booked sales calls, paid on performance

What it is. You put qualified sales calls on their calendar and they pay for the calls that happen. You are their outsourced setting team. The guarantee is the offer, and these are the two biggest advertisers in the whole category.

How it works. Jarvis builds the list of their ideal buyers, writes the outreach and sends it across email, LinkedIn and SMS. Replies get qualified and booked straight into the client's calendar. The big players do this with a room of human setters, which is why they need hundreds of ads to feed it. You run it with AI and one person checking replies before a call goes on the calendar.

Who buys it and why. Coaches, agencies, B2B companies, anyone whose revenue starts with a sales call. Their closers sit idle when the calendar is empty, and an empty calendar has a very clear dollar figure. You charge per booked call that shows, or a monthly retainer with a minimum number of calls.

Running it now. Cole Gordon, 431 ads: "Our setters perform or you don't pay". Aaron Burnham, 196 ads: "Sales calls on your calendar in 14 days". SMGP: "10 or 20 qualified meetings a month".

The offer in six lines
NicheMarketing agencies with a closer and an empty calendar
OutcomeTen qualified sales calls on your calendar every month
TimeframeFirst calls booked within 14 days
Risk reversalCalls that do not show, you do not pay for
Authority or proofThe same outbound system that booked this call, shown live
Unique mechanismAn AI outbound team that researches, writes and chases every prospect, with a human checking every reply

3. Pay per show appointments

What it is. You bring booked appointments to a local business and they pay for each one that walks through the door. Not leads. Not calls. People who turn up. It kills the biggest complaint about lead gen in one line.

How it works. You run simple ads to a short form, and AI takes it from there: replies within a minute, qualifies, books, sends a reminder the day before and the morning of, and rebooks anyone who misses. You get paid per show. This one only works if you can get leads, either through ads you run yourself or a lead source you buy. If you can media buy, it is one of the cleanest offers there is, because the client cannot lose.

Who buys it and why. Med spas, dental, gyms, clinics, anyone who has paid for "leads" that never showed. You charge a set price per appointment that shows, sometimes with the client covering the ad spend on top.

Running it now. Virtual Blue Agency, 66 ads: "Stop buying no show leads, pay only when they show up".

The offer in six lines
NicheMed spas with two or more treatment rooms
OutcomeTwenty new patients in the chair every month
TimeframeFirst bookings within 7 days of going live
Risk reversalYou only pay for the ones that show up
Authority or proofThe demo: an enquiry, two reminders and a confirmation, on your phone, in two minutes
Unique mechanismThe Show Up System, AI follow up and reminders from the moment they enquire until they walk in

4. Pay per lead for local trades

What it is. You run the ads, you qualify the enquiries, and the trade pays per lead or a flat monthly fee. "We find the leads, you do the work." Plain local language wins.

How it works. Statics on Facebook aimed at homeowners in their area, a short form, and AI that texts the enquiry back within a minute, asks the three qualifying questions (what, where, when) and sends the clean lead to the tradie's phone. The time wasters never reach them. Directories sell the same lead to five tradies. You sell it to one.

Who buys it and why. Builders, roofers, concreters, landscapers, mortgage brokers. Big job values, no marketing person, already used to paying for leads. You charge per qualified lead, or a flat monthly plus the ad spend.

Running it now. Enhanced AI in the UK, 20 ads: "We find leads, you build". Tradie Pulse in Australia: "$44K in roofing, real jobs". Con The Builder: "$700 spent, $98K won". BrokerGrow for mortgage brokers.

The offer in six lines
NicheRoofing companies in your city with two or more crews
OutcomeFifteen qualified roofing enquiries a month, in your area, straight to your phone
TimeframeFirst leads within 7 days
Risk reversalNo qualified leads in the first 30 days, your money back
Authority or proofYour own ad and a lead landing in a phone, shown on the call
Unique mechanismAds to homeowners in your postcodes, with AI qualifying every enquiry before it reaches you

5. AI appointment setter on the leads they already have

What it is. Most businesses do not have a lead problem, they have a follow up problem. Leads come in from their ads, Google, directories and website, and sit unanswered for hours. This is an AI setter that answers every lead in under a minute, by text, qualifies it and books it. You do not bring the leads. They already pay for them. You turn them into appointments.

How it works. Connect every lead source they have to the setter. New lead: a text within 60 seconds, a short back and forth, a booking into their calendar, reminders. No reply: it follows up on day one, three and seven until they book or say no. Old leads: it wakes up the whole database they gave up on.

Who buys it and why. Anyone already spending on leads. Real estate, home services, clinics, gyms, car dealers. They can see the leads they paid for going cold, so the dollar figure is already in their head. You charge a setup fee and a monthly fee, priced against the setter wage or the leads they are wasting.

Running it now. Text Maddie, 28 ads: "Generate more revenue from every lead". Growsy AI: "Every lead answered, even at 2am".

The offer in six lines
NicheReal estate agencies running ads for appraisals
OutcomeEvery enquiry answered in under a minute and booked into an appraisal
TimeframeLive in 7 days
Risk reversalNo extra appraisals booked in 30 days, you pay nothing
Authority or proofFill in the test form and watch the texts land on your phone
Unique mechanismThe 60 Second Setter, connected to every lead source you have and chasing until they book

6. Outbound lead generation system, built for them

What it is. Instead of selling meetings one at a time, you build the machine and hand it over, or run it for them. The leads come from cold outbound: a list, email, LinkedIn and calls, with AI doing the research, the writing and the chasing.

How it works. Jarvis builds their ideal customer list, writes personalised outreach, sends it from their own domain, handles the replies, books meetings into their calendar and tracks every contact in a CRM. You hand it over with training, or you run it for a monthly fee.

Who buys it and why. B2B companies and agencies with no outbound team: software, recruitment, commercial services. Hiring a salesperson to do this costs a wage plus six months of ramp. You charge a build fee, then a monthly fee if you run it.

Running it now. Growsy AI: "10 meetings in 30 days, no SDR hire". Search "done for you cold email system" in the Ad Library for a dozen more.

The offer in six lines
NicheB2B software companies with no outbound team
OutcomeA working outbound system booking ten meetings a month, without a sales hire
TimeframeBuilt and sending in 21 days
Risk reversalNo meetings in the first 60 days, I work for free until there are
Authority or proofIt is the system that got you this meeting
Unique mechanismAI researched, AI written outreach from your own domain, with every reply handled and booked

7. Done for you marketing, run with AI end to end

What it is. You are their marketing department. Ads, landing page, funnel, follow up, reporting, the lot. AI does most of the work, so one person runs what used to take an agency of ten.

How it works. AI writes the ad scripts. They film on their phone, or you do. AI edits the videos and makes the statics. Jarvis builds the landing page and the booking funnel. You launch and manage the ads. The AI setter follows up every lead that comes in. The client sees a campaign running and a number going up every month.

Who buys it and why. Local businesses with a proven service and no idea how to advertise it. Trades, clinics, gyms, restaurants. They have tried an agency and got a report instead of customers. You charge a monthly retainer plus the ad spend.

Running it now. Josiah: "We film, edit and run your ads". Tradie Pulse and Con The Builder are this offer for trades.

The offer in six lines
NicheGyms and studios with 150 or more members
OutcomeA full marketing system, from ads to booked trials, running every month
TimeframeLive in 14 days
Risk reversalNo booked trials in the first 30 days, that month is free
Authority or proofYour own ads and page as the case study
Unique mechanismOne system: ads, page, follow up and reporting, built and run by AI with me on top of it

8. One CRM that replaces the stack

What it is. A business paying for ten apps and still running on spreadsheets and an admin's memory. You build one system that runs the whole company and switch the ten apps off. This is where my biggest deals come from, including a $22,000 construction CRM.

How it works. One discovery call mapping how a job moves through their business and what every app costs in money and hours. Then Jarvis builds the one system: leads, quotes, jobs, scheduling, invoicing and reporting in one place, with automations doing the chasing. You move their data across, train the team and turn the old apps off.

Who buys it and why. Established businesses with staff, usually trades and construction, with a wage going on work a system could do. You charge a build fee, then a monthly support fee. Never sold from a page: outreach, a discovery call where you put a dollar figure on the mess, then a proposal.

Running it now. Roof Flow AI: "10 apps, 10 bills, one roofing CRM that replaces them all".

The offer in six lines
NicheResidential builders with five or more staff
OutcomeEvery job, quote and invoice in one system, with the admin done automatically
TimeframeLive in 45 days
Risk reversalIf it does not replace the apps we named, you do not pay the final instalment
Authority or proofA two minute video of a job moving through the system, start to finish
Unique mechanismA system built around how your jobs actually run, not software you bend to fit

9. An AI employee for one job

What it is. Not "AI for your business". One job a person does today, done by an AI: quoting, invoice chasing, scheduling, onboarding, reporting. Priced against the wage it replaces.

How it works. Pick the one job. Watch how they do it today. Build the agent with Jarvis to do it the same way, run it beside the person for two weeks, then hand it over. The person gets their week back or moves to work that makes money.

Who buys it and why. Any business with someone spending hours a week on repeatable admin. You charge a setup fee and a monthly fee that is a fraction of the wage.

Running it now. Automation Agency, 16 ads: "Hire your first (or next) AI employee". The software players run the same line with hundreds of ads behind it.

The offer in six lines
NicheElectrical contractors sending twenty or more quotes a week
OutcomeEvery quote written and sent the same day, without you touching it
TimeframeLive in 14 days
Risk reversalIf it is not saving you ten hours a week by day 30, your money back
Authority or proofWatch it turn a site note into a finished quote on the call
Unique mechanismThe Quoting Agent, trained on your price book and your last hundred quotes

10. Reviews and Google Business

What it is. Every finished job becomes a Google review, automatically, and the business climbs the map. Cheap to run, easy to prove, and the front door to every bigger offer above.

How it works. Job marked done, a text goes out with the review link. Nothing after two days, a reminder. Every review gets a reply written by AI in the owner's voice. The owner watches the count climb and the phone ring more.

Who buys it and why. Any local business that lives on Google: trades, clinics, salons, restaurants. You charge a small monthly fee. The point is the next offer, once they trust you.

Running it now. Nova Codes runs it as one of their lines: "Every client asked for a Google review".

The offer in six lines
NicheDental clinics with under fifty Google reviews
OutcomeA new five star review every week, on autopilot
TimeframeFirst reviews within 7 days
Risk reversalNo new reviews in 30 days, you pay nothing
Authority or proofA review request sent from your system while they watch
Unique mechanismA review request after every visit, a reminder, and AI written replies in your voice

This list grows. As more of you get clients, I add what is working for members in the group, with the numbers.

Pick one. Then see what an irresistible offer reads like in full, and let Jarvis write yours.
